verdict.rationale: Raygun offers an AI Resolution chat feature that lets users converse with an LLM about a specific error's stack trace to get fix suggestions (raygun-docs-4, raygun-docs-27, raygun-docs-30, raygun-docs-32), and an official MCP server exists (raygun-probe-3) that would let AI agents query/operate Raygun via natural language. However, this NL interaction is scoped narrowly to error diagnosis/resolution rather than broader product operation (e.g., managing deployments, dashboards, alerts) via natural language commands, and there's no llms.txt or first-party documentation of a general NL command interface (raygun-probe-1, raygun-probe-2). Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over broader product functions beyond error chat, first-party docs describing the MCP server's capabilities, and independent confirmation the MCP server works as a general command interface.
